sample_unit: AI queries (3 systems x 5 repeats) for a single case

links.outcome: Consistency and correctness of multimodal AI outputs across systems and five repeated runs
links.effect: Outputs were discordant between three systems; one system was incorrect in a stable, reproducible way. Repeated queries were reproducible, but reproducibility did not ensure correctness.
links.quote: The artificial intelligence outputs were discordant between systems and, in one system, incorrect in a stable and reproducible way; this illustrates current limitations rather than clinical readiness and supports the need for prespecified, blinded, multi-case validation before clinical deployment.

screen.reason: The authors evaluated the diagnostic reasoning/readiness of three multimodal AI systems on a complex clinical case presentation, assessing output reproducibility and discordance without testing a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
